build_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a weighted finite-state graph with start and accept nodes and labeled arcs using gtn.Graph
save_and_load_graphs: save a graph to a file with gtn.savetxt and load it back with gtn.loadtxt
test_scalar_graph_operations: test arithmetic operations like negate, add, and subtract on scalar graphs using gtn.scalar_graph
run_autograd_backward_pass: run backward pass on graph operations to compute gradients using gtn.backward and calc_grad
test_parallel_graph_operations: test batch operations on lists of graphs using gtn.add, gtn.concat, and gtn.parallel_for
